name: Navigation Blocks
description: Provides some navigational blocks, like a generic back button that, given a certain entity type, bundle or url, takes the user back to a preferred location.
project_description: Navigation Blocks ships a family of front-end block plugins that help visitors move around a Drupal site. Its centrepiece is a configurable 'back button' that, unlike the browser's own back action, can be pointed at a preferred set of paths, at the canonical page of the entity being viewed, or at an entity reached through an entity-reference field (in either direction). A separate Table of Contents block builds an in-page heading navigation via client-side JavaScript, with an optional CKEditor 4 button for marking headings. The module registers only block plugins and helper services; it adds no routes, permissions or config schema of its own, and all placement/configuration happens through Drupal core's Block UI.
